konjunktion.text_de: New Moon nature: will and feeling act as one. A strong personality, but difficulty in taking in other perspectives. The relationship with mother and father leaves a deep mark. Great vitality, a clear sense of purpose.

sextil.text_de: Will and feelings complement each other well. Emotional balance helps goals to be carried out. Good relations with mother and father. Adaptability and charm.

quadrat.text_de: Inner conflict between will and feeling. Relations with the parents often fraught with tension. Drive born of inner friction. A tendency to contradictory behavior. Growth through self-reflection.

trigon.text_de: Harmony akin to the Full Moon: will and feeling flow together. Natural radiance and popularity. Relations with the parents are helpful. Ease in expressing one's own identity.

opposition.text_de: Polarity between the self and the world of relationships. Wavering between the will and emotional needs. Partnership as a mirror of inner conflicts. Maturing through bringing both principles into balance.

konjunktion.text_de: Combust Mercury (cazimi if within 1°, combustion if 1–8°): will and intellect are closely bound together. Firm opinions, a lively mind, self-centeredness in communication. If cazimi: exceptional clarity of mind and a gift for language.
Charismatic, art-loving, socially charming, delighting in beauty and in life. Pleasure-loving, attractive, often creatively gifted. A tendency to self-love or self-indulgence.

sextil.text_de: An amiable, sociable personality. Art and beauty play a supporting role in daily life. Good diplomatic skills and a pleasant disposition.

konjunktion.text_de: Strong willpower, drive and assertiveness. Courage and a love of risk. A tendency to aggression, impulsiveness and accidents. Pioneering spirit and athletic energy.

sextil.text_de: Energy and will well channeled. Assertive without excessive aggression. An athletic, active character. Favorable for positions of leadership.

quadrat.text_de: Inner tension between ego and driving force. Conflicts with authorities or with men. Great energy, but hard to control. Danger of accidents. Growth through discipline and channeling.

trigon.text_de: Energy and vitality flow harmoniously. A natural style of leadership, courage without recklessness. Athletic talent, delight in competition.

opposition.text_de: Outward resistance rouses the fighting spirit. Conflicts with others flare up over questions of power. Partnership often burdened by rivalry or aggression.

konjunktion.text_de: Optimism, generosity, good fortune and expansion. A tendency to exaggeration and overestimating oneself. Favorable for travel, education and advancement in one's career. Natural authority and breadth of vision.

sextil.text_de: Good fortune and optimism support one's unfolding. A good capacity for learning and foresight. Social generosity. Favorable for study and career.

quadrat.text_de: Overweening ambition or hubris. Promises that are not kept. Legal or religious conflicts. Growth through self-restraint and realism.

trigon.text_de: Exceptional good fortune and natural optimism. Advancement through influential men and mentors. Career opportunities come of their own accord. Moral breadth of vision.

opposition.text_de: Tension between self-interest and the greater whole. Partners or society hold back the expression of the ego. Lesson to learn: modesty and collective responsibility.

konjunktion.text_de: Seriousness, discipline and endurance shape the personality. Relationship with the father often cool or demanding. A slow rise, but lasting results. A tendency to melancholy or to excessive demands on oneself.

sextil.text_de: Discipline and a sense of responsibility help in reaching goals. A practical, reliable character. Favorable for a career built on perseverance.

quadrat.text_de: Inner blockages, lack of self-confidence or excessive self-criticism. Relationship with the father a burden. Obstacles in one's career as a lesson. Growth through perseverance despite resistance.

trigon.text_de: Discipline and ambition harmoniously joined. Long-term building comes naturally. A mature presence, reliability and the respect of others.

opposition.text_de: Outward restrictions and conflicts with authority. Society or partners limit self-development. Lesson to learn: balance between self-assertion and duty.

konjunktion.text_de: Rebellion, originality and an urge for independence. An innovative mind, a gift for technology or science. Unpredictability and difficulty with authorities and conventions.

quadrat.text_de: A revolutionary urge meets inner or outer rigidity. Ruptures and sudden changes. Lesson to learn: dealing constructively with the urge for freedom.

trigon.text_de: Creative originality flows harmoniously. Pioneering spirit without destruction. Favorable for innovation, technology and unconventional careers.

opposition.text_de: The urge for freedom meets the expectations of one's surroundings. Tensions within groups. Revolutionary behavior in relationships. The role of the outsider.

konjunktion.text_de: A sensitive, spiritually gifted personality. Artistic and mediumistic abilities. Difficulty in clearly setting the boundaries of the self; a tendency to idealism or self-deception.

quadrat.text_de: Ideals collide with reality. Danger of disappointment, self-deception or confusion about one's own identity. Growth through spiritual maturity.

trigon.text_de: Spiritual gifts and artistic intuition flow harmoniously. Favorable for art, spirituality and the healing professions.

opposition.text_de: Reality and ideals at odds. Partners or surroundings project illusions. A tendency to disappointments in relationships.

konjunktion.text_de: Intense willpower and an urge for transformation. A magnetic personality with a leaning toward control or questions of power. A deep capacity for regeneration. Crises as catalysts.

quadrat.text_de: Power struggles, compulsive control or self-destruction as the challenge. Deep psychological rebuilding is needed. Growth through letting go.

trigon.text_de: The power of transformation harmoniously unfolded. Strong inner resources, a capacity for regeneration, natural strength in leadership.

opposition.text_de: Power struggles in relationships. Others reflect one's dark sides back. Lesson to learn: sharing power and resources.

konjunktion.text_de: Feeling and intellect closely joined. A lively, communicative mind with an emotional coloring. A good memory, a feel for language. A tendency to overanalyze feelings.

quadrat.text_de: Tension between feeling and reason. Nervous irritability. Communication emotionally overcharged. Lesson to learn: rational distance from emotions.

trigon.text_de: Intuition and intelligence in accord. An eloquent, empathetic way of communicating. Favorable for writing, teaching and counseling.

opposition.text_de: Emotions and rational analysis at odds. Difficulty in putting feelings clearly into words. Disagreements with people close to one.

konjunktion.text_de: Emotional warmth, attractiveness and the need for love are strongly marked. A sense for art, love of pleasure, domesticity. A very pleasant social nature. A tendency to self-indulgence.

quadrat.text_de: Emotional needs and wishes in love at odds. Dependence in love relationships. Jealousy or oversensitivity. Growth through self-love.

trigon.text_de: A loving, harmonious nature. Natural attractiveness and social popularity. Favorable for love relationships and creative pursuits.

opposition.text_de: Emotional needs and romantic ideals collide. Love relationships emotionally intense. A conflict between mother and wife is possible.

konjunktion.text_de: Explosive emotionality and drive. Impulsive, passionate, quick to anger. Great energy, but hard to steer. Favorable for sports and physical activity.

quadrat.text_de: Inner restlessness and emotional aggressiveness. Conflicts in the home. A tendency to accidents. Growth through impulse control.

trigon.text_de: Emotional energy well channeled. A protective, courageous character. Favorable for leadership at home and in social life.

opposition.text_de: Emotional needs collide with the urge to assert oneself. Conflicts in partnership or family. Aggression as a defense against emotional vulnerability.

konjunktion.text_de: Emotional generosity, optimism and care for others. Favorable for family, home life and social engagement. Popularity and goodwill from those around one.

quadrat.text_de: Emotional excess and a sense of entitlement. Exhaustion through excessive caring. Weight problems from emotional eating are possible.

trigon.text_de: Emotional abundance and joy of living. Happiness through family and community life. Favorable for social professions and education.

opposition.text_de: Emotional ideals collide with reality. Exaggerated expectations in relationships. Tension between home and the wide world.

konjunktion.text_de: Emotional coldness or reserve. The mother theme is marked by distance or a sense of duty. Melancholy and inner loneliness as a formative imprint. Maturity and reliability as strengths.

quadrat.text_de: Suppressed emotions and emotional blockages. Relationship with the mother burdened. A tendency to depression. Lesson to learn: allowing and showing feelings.

trigon.text_de: Emotional maturity and reliability. Disciplined care for others. Favorable for responsibility in family and career.

opposition.text_de: Emotional needs are suppressed by outward duties or by partners. Coldness in relationships. Lesson to learn: balance between caring for oneself and responsibility.

konjunktion.text_de: Unusual emotionality, inner restlessness and originality. Relationship with the mother unconventional. Strong intuition and sensitivity to collective currents.

quadrat.text_de: Inner restlessness and swings of mood. Sudden emotional ruptures. Instability in relationships.

trigon.text_de: Emotional freedom and originality in harmony. Favorable for creativity and alternative ways of life.

opposition.text_de: Emotional unpredictability meets the expectations of one's surroundings. Relationships suddenly broken off.

konjunktion.text_de: Great empathy and sensitivity. A dreamlike, mythical inner life. The boundary between self and others blurred. Gifted in art or as a medium.

quadrat.text_de: Illusions and disappointments in matters of feeling. A tendency to escapism. Relationship with the mother idealized or vague.

trigon.text_de: Spiritual empathy and creative imagination flow harmoniously. Favorable for art, healing and spiritual work.

opposition.text_de: Emotional boundaries unclear. Partners project illusions. Self-sacrifice in relationships.

konjunktion.text_de: Intense emotional depth and power of transformation. Relationship with the mother marked by power dynamics or depth. Strong unconscious forces. A capacity for regeneration after emotional crises.

quadrat.text_de: Emotional power struggles and compulsive control. Deep fears and traumas in the background. Growth through psychological work.

trigon.text_de: Emotional depth as a strength. A capacity for transformation and psychological insight. Favorable for the healing professions and crisis work.

opposition.text_de: Power struggles in close relationships. Others set off intense emotional reactions. Lesson to learn: emotional autonomy.

konjunktion.text_de: A talent for language and an aesthetic sense united. Diplomatic communication, charm in speech. A leaning toward art, poetry and pleasant conversation.

sextil.text_de: Communication and social charm well joined. Favorable for diplomacy, negotiation and creative exchange.

konjunktion.text_de: A sharp, direct mind. Rhetorical punch and assertiveness in debate. A tendency to quarrels and sarcasm. Favorable for lawyers and journalists.

quadrat.text_de: Conflicts in communication, reproaches and quarrelsomeness. Hasty decisions. Lesson to learn: thinking before speaking.

trigon.text_de: Intellectual energy and the will to prevail in accord. Favorable for technical professions, debate and negotiation.

opposition.text_de: Intellectual disputes with others. Disagreements escalate easily. Mental challenge through an adversary.

konjunktion.text_de: A far-sighted, optimistic mind. A philosophical way of thinking, delight in learning. A tendency to overblown plans or overestimating oneself.

quadrat.text_de: Grandiloquent schemes never carried through. Exaggeration in communication. Philosophically or religiously dogmatic.

trigon.text_de: Breadth of mind and optimism in harmony. Favorable for teaching, writing, law and philosophy.

opposition.text_de: One's own ideas meet other worldviews. Lesson to learn: intellectual modesty and integrating different points of view.

konjunktion.text_de: A concentrated, structured mind. Thoroughness and care. A tendency to pessimism or reticence in communication. Favorable for science and research.

quadrat.text_de: Mental blockages, brooding and gloomy foreboding. Inhibitions in communication. Lesson to learn: trust in one's own mind.

trigon.text_de: Systematic, reliable thinking. Favorable for mathematics, structural work and analytical professions.

opposition.text_de: One's own ideas are called into question by others. Communication with authorities is difficult.

konjunktion.text_de: Strong attraction and passion. A union of beauty and desire. Great sexual energy and expressiveness. A tendency to impulsiveness in affairs of the heart.

quadrat.text_de: Conflicts in love from the gap between affection and desire. Jealousy, rivalry in love relationships. Creative tension.

trigon.text_de: Love and passion flow harmoniously. Attractive and charismatic. Favorable for creative and romantic undertakings.

opposition.text_de: Tension between the need for harmony and the need for passion. The partner as counterpole in affairs of the heart.

konjunktion.text_de: Good fortune in love and finances. Generous, art-loving, sociable. Favorable for artistic success and social relations. A tendency to extravagance.

quadrat.text_de: Excessive love of pleasure or overspending in love and finances. Favorable, but only with moderation.

trigon.text_de: Natural good fortune and popularity. A sense for art and social generosity. One of the most favorable combinations of planets.

opposition.text_de: Idealized expectations in love. Generosity to the point of naivety. A favorable undercurrent, but with blind spots.

konjunktion.text_de: Love and responsibility joined. Relationships rather serious and lasting. A tendency to privation in affairs of the heart or to love experienced late. Favorable for long-term commitments.

quadrat.text_de: Love withheld or rejection as an imprint from childhood. Fear of rejection. Relationships with a difference in age or a character of duty. Growth through self-love.

trigon.text_de: Faithful, reliable love relationships. Reward for patience and constancy. Favorable for lasting marriages.

opposition.text_de: The partner experienced as restricting. Love relationships with a difference in age or a character of duty. Tension between pleasure and duty.

konjunktion.text_de: High-energy, optimistic and active. Pioneering spirit and a love of adventure. Favorable for sports, enterprise and travel. A tendency to take risks, even to the point of recklessness.

quadrat.text_de: Excessive readiness to take risks. Accidents through recklessness. Conflicts through presumption or arrogance. Energy as a lesson in moderation.

trigon.text_de: Energy and optimism in accord. Favorable for sports, achievement and success in business. A natural engine of good fortune.

opposition.text_de: Others hold back one's drive. Legal or moral conflicts through overzealousness.

konjunktion.text_de: Disciplined energy, purposeful endurance. Energy is channeled through structure. Inner tension between drive and control. Favorable for crafts, the military and hard physical work.

quadrat.text_de: Inner blocking of energy. Frustration and suppressed aggression. A tendency to accidents through pent-up pressure. Lesson to learn: healthy outlets.

trigon.text_de: Endurance and energy perfectly joined. Long-term performance without wearing down. Favorable for long-term physical and professional goals.

opposition.text_de: Outward resistance hinders one's drive. Conflicts with authority and power games. Lesson to learn: patience and strategic waiting.

konjunktion.text_de: A quality of the times for society (the Great Conjunction every 20 years). Personally: balance between expansion and restriction. An important phase of building, with realistic optimism. It marks a generation.

quadrat.text_de: Tension between the wish to grow and the reality principle. Opportunities blocked or delayed. Lesson to learn: realistic planning.

trigon.text_de: Expansion and consolidation in balance. Favorable for sustainable career and financial planning. Integration into society.

opposition.text_de: Social forces in tension: optimism vs. realism in one's social surroundings. Wavering between risk and caution.
